+
+# Lives in the umbrella suite because the mongodb-store Job calls umbrella
+# helpers, so it cannot render with its subchart alone.
+suite: mongodb init job deadline
+release:
+  name: nvsentinel
+  namespace: nvsentinel
+templates:
+  - charts/mongodb-store/templates/jobs.yaml
+set:
+  global.mongodbStore.enabled: true
+tests:
+  - it: gives the init Job a 30 minute deadline by default
+    documentSelector:
+      path: kind
+      value: Job
+    asserts:
+      - equal:
+          path: spec.activeDeadlineSeconds
+          value: 1800
+
+  - it: lets the init Job deadline be configured
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
+    documentSelector:
+      path: kind
+      value: Job
+    asserts:
+      - equal:
+          path: spec.activeDeadlineSeconds
+          value: 3600
+
+  - it: omits the init Job deadline when set to 0
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds: 0
+    documentSelector:
+      path: kind
+      value: Job
+    asserts:
+      - notExists:
+          path: spec.activeDeadlineSeconds
+
+  - it: omits the init Job deadline when given the string "0"
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds: "0"
+    documentSelector:
+      path: kind
+      value: Job
+    asserts:
+      - notExists:
+          path: spec.activeDeadlineSeconds
+
+  - it: keeps the default deadline when the job map is null
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job: null
+    documentSelector:
+      path: kind
+      value: Job
+    asserts:
+      - equal:
+          path: spec.activeDeadlineSeconds
+          value: 1800
+
+  - it: rejects a non-numeric deadline instead of dropping it
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds: soon
+    asserts:
+      - failedTemplate:
+          errorPattern: mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds must be an integer
+
+  - it: rejects a negative deadline
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds: -5
+    asserts:
+      - failedTemplate:
+          errorPattern: mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds must be an integer
+
+  - it: rejects a boolean deadline instead of turning it into 0
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds: false
+    asserts:
+      - failedTemplate:
+          errorPattern: mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds must be an integer
+
+  - it: rejects a fractional deadline instead of turning it into 0
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds: 0.5
+    asserts:
+      - failedTemplate:
+          errorPattern: mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds must be an integer
+
+  - it: rejects a non-scalar deadline instead of turning it into 0
+    set:
+      mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds:
+        nested: 1
+    asserts:
+      - failedTemplate:
+          errorPattern: mongodb-store.job.activeDeadlineSeconds must be an integer

@@ -209,6 +209,37 @@ kubectl get pods -n {namespace} -l app.kubernetes.io/component=mongod
 
 The `perconaservermongodb` resource must reach `ready`, and the init Job (`-l app.kubernetes.io/name=create-mongodb-database`) must complete.
 
+### Init Job deadline
+
+The init Job that creates the database users (`create-mongodb-database`) fails once it runs longer than `activeDeadlineSeconds`. On a cold node, image pulls can queue long enough to hit it, and Helm does not re-create a failed Job. Set the deadline next to `nodeSelector` and `tolerations`:
+
+```yaml
+mongodb-store:
+  job:
+    activeDeadlineSeconds: 1800   # default; 0 omits the deadline
+```
+
+With an external MongoDB (`mongodbStore.enabled=false`), the setup Job reads its own value instead (default `600`):
+
+```yaml
+global:
+  datastore:
+    setupJob:
+      activeDeadlineSeconds: 600
+```
+
+Raising the value does not restart a Job that already failed. Delete the failed Job and run `helm upgrade` again. For the mongodb-store Job:
+
+```bash
+kubectl delete job -l app.kubernetes.io/name=create-mongodb-database -n {namespace}
+```
+
+For the external MongoDB setup Job:
+
+```bash
+kubectl delete job -l app.kubernetes.io/name=external-mongodb-setup -n {namespace}
+```
+
